task: v13 compact straight sofa interior concept set
method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; one native sofa anchor per concept followed by independent dependent edits for table and floor variants.
design_status: Original inspiration concepts; not exact Camerich product replicas.
scale_note: Approximately 205–215 cm visual sofa scale; slim target approximately 208 cm. Real-world dimensions are not measured or certified from these images.
resolution_requirement: Native 1536×1024 or larger, landscape 3:2. No upscaling, downscaling, compositing or post-generation pixel edits.

limitations: Generative visual concepts cannot certify furniture dimensions, product construction or real-world fit.
Minor texture and light variation may occur between generated images; camera, architecture and visible furniture identity were visually checked.
Oak board direction differs between the two sofa concepts while both use straight planks.
